title: Code and data for: Seasonal structuring of microbial communities and functional potential in a Patagonian fjord
description: Analysis code, processed data (phyloseq objects, CoverM coverage, GTDB-Tk R232 classifications, gene-by-MAG matrices) and the marker protein database (Greening lab metabolic marker gene databases plus UniProt sets) for a seasonal, genome-resolved study of bacterioplankton in the Comau Fjord, northern Patagonia, Chile. Code is MIT licensed; data, database and results are CC BY 4.0.
